optional
List of Account IDs to filter by. Example:
"4,2,6,4,1,8,0,3,0,2,1,2,0,7,3,7,6,2".
optional
Unique ID of the uploaded indicators batch. Example:
"atmtn000000028a881bcf939dc6d92ab55443".
optional
The categories of the Threat Intelligence indicator, e.g.  the malware
type associated with the IOC
optional
If true, only total number of items will be returned, without any of
the actual objects.
optional
Creation Time as set by the user greater than. Example:
"2021-07-12T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
Creation Time as set by the user greater or equal than. Example:
"2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
Creation Time as set by the user lesser than. Example:
"2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
Creation Time as set by the user lesser or equal than. Example:
"2021-07-11T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
Free-text filter by the user uploaded the Threat Intelligence indicator
(supports multiple values). Example: "admin@sentinelone.com".
optional
Cursor position returned by the last request. Should be used for
iterating over more than 1000 items. Example:
"YWdlbnRfaWQ6NTgwMjkzODE=".
optional
Free-text filter by the description of the indicator (supports multiple
values). Example: "Malicious-activity".
optional
The unique identifier of the indicator as provided by the Threat
1865
Intelligence source. Example: "e277603e-1060-5ad4-9937-
c26c97f1ca68".
optional
Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".
optional
Free-text filter by the Indicator name (supports multiple values).
Example: "foo.dll".
optional
Skip first number of items (0-1000). For iterating over more than a
1000 items please use "cursor" instead. Example: "150".
optional
If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up
execution time
optional
The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".
optional
Sort direction. Example: "asc".
optional
List of the sources of the identified Threat Intelligence indicator.
Example: "AlienVault".
optional
The type of the Threat Intelligence indicator. Example: "IPv4".
optional
The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB
greater than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB
greater or equal than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB
lesser than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the indicator was last updated in SentinelOne DB
lesser or equal than. Example: "2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the Threat Intelligence indicator was uploaded to
SentinelOne DB greater than. Example:
"2022-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the Threat Intelligence indicator was uploaded to
SentinelOne DB greater or equal than. Example:
"2022-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the Threat Intelligence indicator was uploaded to
SentinelOne DB lesser than. Example:
"2021-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
The time at which the Threat Intelligence indicator was uploaded to
SentinelOne DB lesser or equal than. Example:
"2022-07-13T20:33:29.007906Z".
optional
A list of unique Ids of the parent process of the indicator of
1866
compromise. Example:
"2,c,f,f,a,e,8,7,1,1,9,7,f,2,0,d,8,6,4,f,e,8,3,6,3,e,e,e,6,6,5,1".
optional
The value of the Threat Intelligence indicator. Example:
"175.45.176.1".
